item.description: ### Improved - **Claude Code's status line renders faster.** Perch's status-line helper runs on every render, and it was spending about 20 ms per render searching a quarter-megabyte config file for your account and plan. It now reads the file once and finds both in under half a millisecond. What it shows is unchanged. - **Perch's four-second scan can now be coalesced with other timers.** The timer allows a second of slack so macOS can batch its wake with other work, which is what an idle Mac actually pays for a periodic check.
